subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1c9077be0d9581e674d811b0933377a123c857f2b42fec2d8392469651c5766.png]
solution:
Here, we use the figure (1) and (2) to find opposite faces, From the common number (1) written faces number in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/978870fd62fb1e15573d327d0cf45dc757184874f616c6f181807f23b97becc4.png] 

Here, the opposite of face showing 6 is **face showing 4.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
